**Finding submitted: MISSING (insurance)**

The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere — a full-text search for "insurance" returns nothing, and neither General Matters (sub-clauses (a)–(j)) nor the IP indemnity section imposes any coverage or certificate obligation on Garman. Since Garman performs delivery, installation, data conversion, training and on-site maintenance involving Sparkling's data, the complete absence of coverage falls into the rule's walk-away territory rather than the fallback.

Redline (validated, ok:true): a new General Matters sub-clause (k) after the entire-agreement clause, at the preferred limits — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Sparkling data is processed, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request — with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the comment.
